source_summary: Amana product tables on toolstoday.com (Amana's own retail site; amanatool.com blocks scripted access) + Amana speed charts (amanatool.com/pub/media/productattachments). Extended 2026-10-09 from toolstoday.com variant pages (one page per Amana part: diameter, cutting height, shank, overall length, flutes, angle, radius, tip width, coating, max RPM); flute counts for the 45760-45777 signmaking engravers from cncshop.ca listings. Dovetail angles stored as included (2x Amana's per-side angle).
